title: Eject a CD, DVD, or USB drive
summary: Safely eject removable media like CDs, DVDs, or USB sticks. You can eject the default device or specify a particular drive path.

steps.explain: Eject the default removable device (usually the first CD/DVD drive found).
Alternatively, eject a specific device by its path (e.g., /dev/cdrom).

placeholders.name: DEVICE_PATH
placeholders.description: The path to the device you want to eject, such as /dev/cdrom or /dev/sdb1.

placeholders.name: DEVICE_PATH
placeholders.description: The path to the CD/DVD drive.

placeholders.name: DEVICE_PATH
placeholders.description: The path to the floppy drive.

placeholders.name: DEVICE_PATH
placeholders.description: The path to the tape drive.
